OperationalRequest.title: OperationalRequest
OperationalRequest.description: Represents an operational data request within the CareEdge BFSI Rating platform.

requestId.description: Unique identifier for the operational request.

companyId.description: Identifier for the company associated with the request.

financialInputSector.description: Sector of the company for financial input.

listed.description: Indicates if the company is listed (Yes/No).

assignedTo.description: User ID of the analyst assigned to the request.

status.description: Status of the request (PENDING, ACCEPTED, CLOSED).

remarks.description: Remarks or notes related to the request.

receiptDateTime.description: Timestamp when the request was received.

receiptResponseDateTime.description: Timestamp when a response to the request was received.

entryAllottedDateTime.description: Timestamp when the entry was allotted.

entryCompletedDateTime.description: Timestamp when the entry was completed.

checkingAllottedDateTime.description: Timestamp when the checking was allotted.

checkingCompletedDateTime.description: Timestamp when the checking was completed.

sentBackFlag.description: Flag indicating if the request was sent back.

path.description: Path or location of the item.

ckcAnalystName.description: Name of the CKC Analyst assigned to the request.

id.description: Unique identifier for the OperationalRequest entity.

definition.description: Stores operational data requests. Includes denormalized 'assignedTo' field (CKC Analyst ID) to enable Authorization Independence and DBAC. The status field indicates the lifecycle stage (PENDING, ACCEPTED, CLOSED).

params.name: requestId
params.description: Unique identifier for the operational request.

definition.description: Documents in this collection signify that a user is an admin. Existence, not content, is used for authorization. Allows DBAC (Database-Based Access Control) and simple security rules.

params.name: uid
params.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the user with the admin role.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore data structure is designed to support the CareEdge BFSI Rating platform's operational data input workflow, focusing on security, scalability, and ease of querying. The core principle is **Authorization Independence**, achieved through denormalization. Specifically, the `assignedTo` field, representing the CKC Analyst, is present within each `ckc_operational_requests` document. This design avoids the need for `get()` calls in security rules to check ownership, thus enabling atomic operations and simplifying rule logic.  This supports role-based access control, ensuring that CKC Analysts can only access requests assigned to them while CKC Admins have view-only access to all requests.

To support the QAPs (Rules are not Filters) requirement, the design leverages Structural Segregation (Homogeneous Security Posture).  All documents within the `ckc_operational_requests` collection share the same security requirements regarding read and write access, based on the status and the assigned analyst.  Given the explicit segregation of concerns achieved, a membership map is not required.
